slides.texte_overlay:
Questions every man
should ask his father

1. "What was your first job?"

You'll hear a story
you never knew.

2. "How did you meet Mom?"

Every family has
a beginning.

3. "What do you wish you'd
done differently?"

His mistakes can
save you years.

4. "What were you afraid of
at my age?"

You'll feel less alone.

5. "What are you proud of?"

Most dads never get asked.

6. "What's something you still
want to learn?"

Then learn it together.
slides.texte_sophia:
6. "What's something you still
want to learn?"

I found him lessons on the
Sophia app. We learn together.
